messages:
ana: Heads-up — invoice-preview spike for tenant=acme-corp around 16:12 UTC. Numbers look like duplicate credits from the ingest sidewatermark reordering. Anyone seen this pattern before?
ben: saw similar yesterday but assumed it was late-arrival events. Can you paste the preview diff?
ana: small sample attached below. It's the preview pipeline output where two events for same session ended up in different windows.
ana: ```
{"tenant":"acme-corp","session_id":"s-123","tokens":120,"event_time":1688000001}
{"tenant":"acme-corp","session_id":"s-123","tokens":80,"event_time":1688000002}
```
carla: that looks like watermark moved backwards because of shard reorder. Which ingest shard handled these?
ana: shard=shard-17, proxy=edge-v2. There's a small backpressure window on that shard this morning.
ben: can we correlate with checkpoint lag? prometheus query I ran: `max_over_time(watermark_lag_seconds{shard="shard-17"}[1h])` spikes to 65s around the same time.
dion: deploy-bot reports a config rollout at 16:00 that touched ingest windowing: deploy-bot: "deployed ingest-window-adjuster v2.3 to shard-*/edge-proxy"
elaine: oh — that rollout toggles the watermark smoothing alpha. If smoothing drops too low, reordering can move watermarks backwards.
carla: short-term mitigation: revert the canary change on shard-17 and re-run preview backfill. Who can roll it back?
ben: I can revert the canary for shard-17 now. Quick question: will reverting re-trigger duplicates in preview again?
ana: replay/backfill plan: when we revert, we should mark that preview batch as idempotent using request_id dedupe. Otherwise invoice preview will show both.
dion: adding a quick dashboard card to track `invoice_preview_duplicates_total` and `watermark_retracts_total` — will push to console now.
dion: prometheus expr I added: `increase(watermark_retracts_total[10m]) / increase(invoice_preview_events_total[10m])` — gives a retract rate.
elaine: longer-term: suggest changing algorithm to prefer processing-time monotonic watermarks per shard with event-time correction at aggregation stage. That keeps preview stable while still accounting for late events later.
carla: agree on approach. Also need UX change: console should surface a "preview-unreliable" tag when retract rate > 0.5% so PMs aren't misled.
ben: rolling back now on shard-17. I'll update when done. :hammer_and_wrench: 
ben: rollback complete at 16:21 UTC. Monitoring now.
ana: after rollback, preview duplicates dropped to baseline — confirmed in the preview table. Thanks.
elaine: follow-ups: (1) design canary gating for watermark alpha (2) add unit test for watermark monotonicity (3) add console tag for preview reliability. I'll file tickets.
carla: filing two tickets: ENG-1227 (canary gating + metrics), ENG-1228 (console preview-unreliable UX).
ana: leaving note for billing: this was preview-only; invoices should be unaffected because finalizer uses commit-time dedupe. I'll ping finance just in case.
ben: added a lightweight smoke test to CI that asserts `watermark_retracts_total` stays at 0 for synthetic reorder workload.
carla: thanks everyone. Closing the incident for now, will keep the dashboard on for 24h. :white_check_mark:
